definition: Official recognition as an SBI chapter — grants access to HQ support and the freedom to charge for services outside your chapter's boundaries.
Headquarters — the founder and selected executives who support chapters, set standards, and make final calls.
The student who founds and leads a chapter: organizes the team, keeps quality up, and communicates with HQ.
Team role responsible for building client websites using AI — no coding experience required.
Team role that shoots raw footage for client promo videos.
Team role that edits the raw footage from the Cameraman into a finished promo video.
Optional team role that guides video production and editing with marketing techniques to maximize reach.
HQ role that checks chapter work before it goes live to make sure it meets the organization's bar.
HQ role that responds to DMs on social media, points applicants to the site and SOP, and checks Google Form applications.
HQ role that sets up your chapter's social media, walks you through your responsibilities, clears up SOP questions, and recommends businesses to reach out to first.
HQ role chapter leaders message when they're stuck mid-project.
The area around a chapter's community (decided by HQ) where all services must be free. Outside it, chapters may charge.
Loss of official recognition — happens after missing the 2-delivered-projects-per-month target 3 months in a row (negotiable with HQ).
